regions.label: INESHeader
regions.evidence: Validated iNES header: mapper 1, 8x16 KiB PRG and 16x8 KiB CHR, no trainer. workspace.json and baseline verification.

regions.label: CHRPatternROM
regions.evidence: iNES hardware CHR ROM section, exact 128 KiB bounds. NES PPU pattern backing in 16-byte 2bpp tiles; opening and title rendered successfully. No CPU PRG overlap.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: 6502 hardware vector words at CPU FFFA-FFFF in physical bank15: NMI FF00, reset C100, IRQ FF00; reset state confirms C100.
